item.title: Swiss Alps Gravel Traverse
item.description:
A high alpine bikepacking adventure across forgotten passes and silent valleys

This multi-day gravel route takes you across the Swiss Alps, far away from traffic, deep into nature, and high above the valleys. You’ll ride remote pass roads, push your bike on rugged climbs, and sleep under starry skies. Designed for 5–7 days with a tent or lightweight setup.

Route Highlights:

  • Alte Pragelpassstraße (~1550m) – remote forest gravel
  • Klöntal – stunning turquoise lake below vertical cliffs
  • Mountain trail above Linthal – panoramic riding with some hike-a-bike (plus: the best soup I ever had in Urnerboden!)
  • Klausenpass (1948m) – flowing alpine road, waterfalls and wide views
  • Alte Sustenstraße – old gravel route full of character and solitude (my favourite!)
  • Sustenpass (2224m) – glaciers and clean mountain air… and a storm arriving 10 minutes after we reached the top. We stayed for a while in the restaurant (btw: cash only!)
  • Grimselpass (2165m) – wild and windy, above the deep-blue reservoirs

We didn’t expect this view: Grimsel down, Furka up. It was our most emotional moment.

item.title: Mallorca 312
Brevet 300 - Mallorca
Having Fun on Mallorcan Roads
item.description: In April, my friend and I spent five unforgettable days cycling through the stunning roads of Mallorca. From the coastlines to the mountains, the island offered a perfect mix of scenic views, challenging climbs, and thrilling descents. Whether riding along the crystal-clear waters or through charming villages, we discovered the true beauty of Mallorca one pedal stroke at a time. This collection captures our adventure across the island, showcasing some of the best routes that combine fun, challenge, and breathtaking landscapes.

item.title: Brevet 600 - Kintai
item.description:
Paris - Brest - Paris 2023 kvalifikacija

Brevet 600 yra paskutinis kvalifikacinis važiavimas iš 200, 300, 400 ir 600km serijos norintiems dalyvauti seniausiame dviračių renginyje Paris - Brest - Paris (PBP). Šiais metais vyks 27 kartą nuo 1891 metų. PBP sudaro 1200km ir 12000 metrų sukilimo, kuriame dalyvauja ~8000 dalyvių iš viso pasaulio ir jis vyksta kas ketverius metus. 2019 metais turėjau galimybę sudalyvauti ir pats bei visą distanciją įveikiau per 75h:
